entities.name: Japanese destroyer Amagiri
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Amagiri  was the 15th of 24 Fubuki-class destroyers, built for the Imperial Japanese Navy following World War I. She is most famous for ramming the PT-109 commanded by Lieutenant John F. Kennedy, who would later become the 35th President of the United States.
